course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using som to identify places and options when choosing lunch or fika.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues decide where to go for lunch or coffee.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Comparing familiar places and making a practical choice.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss two nearby lunch or fika places and choose the one that fits best today.

main_focus.name: relative clauses with som for places
main_focus.description: Use som after a place noun to explain which place is meant.
model_examples: Vi kan gå till kaféet som ligger vid hörnet.
Restaurangen som öppnade i förra veckan verkar trevlig.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use this structure naturally 2-3 times while comparing options.

useful_chunks: Ska vi prova ett nytt ställe?
Det är närmare än den andra restaurangen.
Vi hinner om vi går nu.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use place words and practical chunks for choosing quickly during a workday.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks where they should go for lunch or fika.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two places using short descriptions with som.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose one place and mention a simple reason.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the relative clause pattern with different place nouns

focus: which place option is preferred and why
what practical detail affects the choice

sentence_focus: one sentence with som describing a café
one sentence about a place being full or closed
one sentence making a lunch suggestion
one sentence giving a reason for the chosen place
